feats/shadow-weave-magic-2568.name: Shadow Weave Magic
feats/shadow-weave-magic-2568.effectSummary: Your spells use the Shadow Weave instead of the Weave, and you can activate Shadow Weave magic items without damage. Enchantment, Illusion, Necromancy, and darkness-descriptor spells gain +1 save DC and +1 on caster-level checks to overcome spell resistance. Evocation and Transmutation spells other than darkness spells use an effective caster level 1 lower, affecting all level-dependent variables and dispel checks; a 1st-level Shadow Weave user therefore cannot cast those schools. You cannot cast light-descriptor spells, and cannot invoke a light-producing item's power through spell-trigger or spell-completion activation. Magic items you create are Shadow Weave items. Taking the feat immediately reduces Wisdom by 2; this loss does not remove the feat if Wisdom drops below 13 and cannot be restored normally. Atonement from a cleric of Shar after the required quest can restore the Wisdom if you adopt Shar as patron; changing patrons causes the loss again.

You are always proficient with your own shield of thought.

feats/tattoo-magic-2893.name: Tattoo Magic
feats/tattoo-magic-2893.effectSummary: Create single-use magic tattoos containing a known spell of 3rd level or lower that targets one or more creatures. Creation takes 1 hour on a corporeal creature; choose a caster level high enough to cast the spell and no higher than your own.
